title: Eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan 100 ta so‘z birikmasi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida eng foydali so‘z birikmalarini, ya’ni fe’l va ot hamda sifat va ot juftliklarini to‘g‘ri ishlata olasiz, so‘zma-so‘z tarjima xatolaridan qochasiz va o‘n beshta birikmadan iborat paragraf yoza olasiz.

scenes.title: So‘z birikmalari dunyosiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say: Welcome! Last time you built complex sentences. Today you will make them sound natural, because fluent English is mostly words that belong together.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda murakkab qo‘shma gaplar tuzishni o‘rgandik. Endi gaplaringiz tabiiy eshitilishi uchun so‘zlarni to‘g‘ri juftlashni o‘rganamiz. Bugun yuzta eng foydali so‘z birikmasi, ya’ni collocation bilan tanishamiz: fe’l va ot, sifat va ot, ular uchun xotira usullari. Dars oxirida o‘n beshta birikmali kichik matn yoza olasiz va ularni uzoq yodda saqlash usulini bilasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan darsda murakkab gaplar tuzdik. Bugun ularni tabiiy qilamiz, chunki ravon ingliz tili asosan bir-biriga mos so‘zlardan iborat.

scenes.title: Collocation nima?

examples.t: We had heavy rain all night.

scenes.say: A collocation is a pair or group of words that native speakers naturally use together. There is often no logical reason. We say heavy rain, not strong rain.
scenes.say_native: Collocation — ingliz tilida bir-biri bilan tabiiy ravishda birga keladigan so‘zlar. Masalan, “make a decision” deymiz, “do a decision” demaymiz. “Heavy rain” to‘g‘ri, “strong rain” esa g‘alati eshitiladi. Buning mantiqiy sababi yo‘q, shunchaki til shunday shakllangan. Shuning uchun yangi so‘zni yakka emas, o‘z sherigi bilan o‘rganing. Shunda gapingiz ona tilida so‘zlashuvchiniki kabi ravon bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Collocation — ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar tabiiy ravishda birga ishlatadigan so‘zlar guruhi. Ko‘pincha mantiqiy sabab yo‘q. Heavy rain deymiz, strong rain demaymiz.

scenes.title: Nega so‘zma-so‘z tarjima ishlamaydi
board: qaror qabul qilmoq → make a decision
scenes.say: Literal translation from Uzbek often fails. In Uzbek you drink medicine and accept a decision. In English you take medicine and make a decision.
scenes.say_native: Collocationlarning asosiy tuzog‘i — so‘zma-so‘z tarjima. O‘zbekchada dori “ichiladi”, ingliz tilida esa “take medicine”, ya’ni dori “olinadi”. O‘zbekchada qaror “qabul qilinadi”, inglizchada esa “make a decision”, ya’ni qaror “yasaladi”. “Xato qilmoq” va “uy vazifasini qilmoq” o‘zbekchada bitta “qilmoq” fe’li bilan aytiladi, inglizchada esa make va do alohida. Shuning uchun tarjima qilmang, tayyor birikmani eslang.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zma-so‘z tarjima ko‘pincha xato. Oʻzbekcha dori ichasiz, inglizchada take medicine deysiz; qaror qabul qilasiz, inglizchada make a decision deysiz.

scenes.title: Make va do: asosiy farq
board: make a plan, a mistake, money, progress
do homework, the dishes, business, research

examples.t: He does the shopping on Fridays.

scenes.say: Make usually creates something new: a plan, a mistake, money. Do usually describes an activity or task: homework, the dishes, research.
scenes.say_native: Eng mashhur juftlik — make va do. Umumiy yo‘l-yo‘riq: “make” biror yangi narsa yaratishni bildiradi, ya’ni natija paydo bo‘ladi: make a plan, make a mistake, make money, make progress. “Do” esa faoliyat yoki vazifa: do homework, do the dishes, do research, do business. Bu qoida to‘liq emas, istisnolar bor, shuning uchun birikmalarni to‘plam qilib yodlash kerak. Ammo ko‘p holatlarda shu qoida sizni to‘g‘ri yo‘lga soladi.
scenes.say_uz: Make odatda yangi narsa yaratadi: reja, xato, pul. Do odatda faoliyat yoki vazifani bildiradi: uy vazifasi, idish yuvish, tadqiqot.

scenes.title: Make bilan yana beshta birikma
scenes.say: More with make: make an effort, make friends, make sense, make a noise, and make a phone call. In American English you often say make a call.
scenes.say_native: Make bilan yana beshta muhim birikma. “Make an effort” — harakat qilmoq. “Make friends” — do‘st orttirmoq, bunda friends ko‘plikda bo‘ladi. “Make sense” — mantiqli bo‘lmoq. “Make a noise” — shovqin qilmoq. “Make a phone call” — qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoq, amerikacha ko‘pincha “make a call”. O‘zbekchada ularning hammasida “qilmoq” yoki “orttirmoq” turlicha, inglizchada esa hammasi make bilan keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Make bilan yana: make an effort, make friends, make sense, make a noise va make a phone call. Amerikacha ko‘pincha make a call.

scenes.title: Do bilan birikmalar

examples.t: Too much sugar does you harm.

scenes.say: With do we say do the shopping, do the washing-up, do your best, do harm, do good and do business. Do is common with general activities.
scenes.say_native: Do bilan ishlatiladigan birikmalar: do the shopping — xarid qilmoq, do the washing-up — idish yuvmoq, bu britancha, amerikaliklar “do the dishes” deydi. Do your best — qo‘lidan kelganini qilmoq. Do harm — zarar yetkazmoq, do good — foyda bermoq. Do business — savdo qilmoq. Bularning barchasida do umumiy faoliyatni bildiradi, o‘zbekchada esa hammasiga “qilmoq” fe’li to‘g‘ri keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Do bilan: do the shopping, do the washing-up, do your best, do harm, do good, do business. Do umumiy faoliyatlar bilan keladi.

scenes.title: Make va do almashib ketadi
scenes.say: Two typical errors. We make a mistake, we do not do a mistake. And we do homework, we do not make homework.
scenes.say_native: Bu xatolar o‘zbek va rus tilidan kelgan odatlar tufayli juda ko‘p uchraydi. O‘zbekchada “xato qilmoq” va “uy vazifasini qilmoq”, ya’ni bir xil fe’l. Inglizchada esa xato yaratiladi, shuning uchun make a mistake. Uy vazifasi esa bajariladigan vazifa, shuning uchun do homework. Bu ikki birikmani avtomatik bo‘lguncha takrorlang. Imtihonda aynan shular tushadi.
scenes.say_uz: Biz make a mistake deymiz, do a mistake demaymiz. Do homework deymiz, make homework demaymiz.

scenes.title: Make yoki do?
scenes.say: Make or do? One: a decision. Two: research. Three: progress. Four: the shopping. Five: friends.
scenes.say_native: Beshta birikma. Har biriga make yoki do fe’lini qo‘ying. Birinchi: a decision. Ikkinchi: research. Uchinchi: progress. To‘rtinchi: the shopping. Beshinchi: friends. Baland ovozda to‘liq ayting, masalan “make a decision”.
scenes.say_uz: Make yoki do? Qaror. Tadqiqot. Taraqqiyot. Xarid. Do‘stlar.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: make a decision. Two: do research. Three: make progress. Four: do the shopping. Five: make friends.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Make a decision. Do research. Make progress. Do the shopping. Make friends. Ko‘rdingizmi, natija yaratadigan birikmalar, ya’ni qaror, taraqqiyot va do‘stlik, make bilan keladi. Tadqiqot va xarid esa faoliyat, shuning uchun do. Agar uchtadan ko‘pini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi boshladingiz.
scenes.say_uz: Make a decision. Do research. Make progress. Do the shopping. Make friends.

scenes.title: Take bilan birikmalar
board: take a photo / a break / a shower

examples.t: The meeting will take place on Monday.

scenes.say: Take is very flexible. Take a photo, take a break, take notes, take medicine, take part in, take place, take a risk, take responsibility, take advantage of.
scenes.say_native: Take juda keng ishlatiladi. Take a photo — suratga olmoq. Take a break — tanaffus qilmoq. Take notes — yozuv olmoq. Take medicine — dori ichmoq. Take part in — ishtirok etmoq. Take place — bo‘lib o‘tmoq, bunda take place voqealar uchun ishlatiladi. Take a risk — tavakkal qilmoq. Take responsibility — mas’uliyatni o‘z zimmasiga olmoq. Take advantage of — imkoniyatdan foydalanmoq. O‘zbekchada ularning har biri boshqa fe’l bilan aytiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Take juda moslashuvchan: take a photo, a break, notes, medicine, part in, place, a risk, responsibility, advantage of.

scenes.title: Have, give, pay, keep, break
board: have a look / lunch / an argument
pay attention / a visit / a fine
keep a promise / in touch / calm
break a rule / a record / the law
scenes.say: More verbs: have a look, give advice, pay attention, keep a promise, break a rule. Learn each verb with its common partners.
scenes.say_native: Yana beshta fe’l va ularning sheriklari. Have a look — qarab chiqmoq, have lunch — tushlik qilmoq, have an argument — janjallashmoq. Give advice — maslahat bermoq, give a presentation — taqdimot qilmoq. Pay attention — e’tibor bermoq, pay a visit — tashrif buyurmoq. Keep a promise — va’daga vafo qilmoq, keep in touch — aloqada bo‘lmoq. Break a rule — qoidani buzmoq, break a record — rekord yangilamoq.
scenes.say_uz: Yana fe’llar: have a look, give advice, pay attention, keep a promise, break a rule. Har bir fe’lni o‘z sheriklari bilan o‘rganing.

scenes.title: Vaqt va pul bilan birikmalar

examples.t: I caught a cold last week.

scenes.say: Time and money have their own partners: spend, waste and save. We catch a cold or a bus, and we miss a bus or a chance.
scenes.say_native: Vaqt va pul bilan o‘z fe’llari keladi. Spend time — vaqt o‘tkazmoq, waste time — vaqtni bekorga sarflamoq, save time — vaqtni tejamoq. Shamollash uchun “catch a cold” deymiz, ya’ni shamollashni “tutib olamiz”. Avtobus uchun ham catch, o‘tkazib yuborsak miss. Britaniyada “catch the bus” keng tarqalgan. “Miss a chance” — imkoniyatni qo‘ldan boy bermoq. O‘zbek tilidagi “o‘tkazmoq” bu yerda spend yoki miss bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt va pul bilan spend, waste va save keladi. Shamollash yoki avtobus bilan catch, o‘tkazib yuborish bilan miss ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Fe’l xatolari
board: ✗ say a lie → ✓ tell a lie
✗ do a photo → ✓ take a photo
✗ do a decision → ✓ make a decision
scenes.say: Four common errors. We tell a lie, we take a photo, we make a decision and we take medicine. Do not translate the Uzbek verb directly.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “say a lie”. To‘g‘ri tell a lie, chunki yolg‘on va haqiqat bilan tell ishlatiladi: tell the truth. Ikkinchisi: “do a photo”. To‘g‘risi take a photo. Uchinchisi: “do a decision”, to‘g‘risi make a decision. To‘rtinchisi: “drink medicine”, to‘g‘risi take medicine. Hammasi o‘zbekcha fe’lni so‘zma-so‘z o‘girishdan chiqadi. Doim ot bilan birga fe’lni ham yodlang.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt xato: say a lie emas, tell a lie. Do a photo emas, take a photo. Do a decision emas, make a decision. Drink medicine emas, take medicine.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri fe’lni toping
scenes.say: Choose the right verb. One: a lie. Two: attention. Three: a cold. Four: a promise. Five: a rule.
scenes.say_native: Beshta birikma uchun to‘g‘ri fe’lni toping. Birinchi: a lie. Ikkinchi: attention. Uchinchi: a cold. To‘rtinchi: a promise. Beshinchi: a rule. Oxirgi ikkitasida ikki xil javob bor, ikkala ma’noni ham ayting, masalan va’dani saqlash yoki buzish mumkin.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri fe’lni toping. Yolg‘on. E’tibor. Shamollash. Va’da. Qoida.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: tell a lie. Two: pay attention. Three: catch a cold. Four: keep or break a promise. Five: break or follow a rule.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Tell a lie. Pay attention. Catch a cold. Va’da bilan keep yoki break, ya’ni saqlash yoki buzish. Qoida bilan break yoki follow, ya’ni buzish yoki unga amal qilish. Bu yerda ikkita to‘g‘ri variant bor edi, chunki ma’no ikki yo‘nalishda ketishi mumkin. Ana shunday ikki tomonlama birikmalar yozuvda ayniqsa foydali.
scenes.say_uz: Tell a lie. Pay attention. Catch a cold. Keep yoki break a promise. Break yoki follow a rule.

scenes.title: Sifat va ot: kuchli yoki og‘ir?

examples.t: There was heavy traffic this morning.
examples.uz: Bugun ertalab yo‘lda tirbandlik kuchli edi.

scenes.say: Adjective plus noun collocations: heavy rain, strong coffee, high prices, deep sleep. The adjective depends on the noun, not on logic.
scenes.say_native: Endi sifat va ot birikmalari. Heavy rain — qattiq yomg‘ir, heavy traffic — tirbandlik, heavy smoker — ko‘p chekuvchi. Strong coffee — kuchli qahva, strong wind — kuchli shamol, strong accent — sezilarli talaffuz. High price — yuqori narx, high temperature — yuqori harorat. Deep sleep — chuqur uyqu, deep breath — chuqur nafas. Bir xil o‘zbekcha “kuchli” yoki “qattiq” inglizchada ottaga qarab o‘zgaradi, shuning uchun juftlarni yod oling.
scenes.say_uz: Sifat va ot: heavy rain, strong coffee, high prices, deep sleep. Sifat ot ga bog‘liq, mantiqqa emas.

scenes.title: Yana foydali sifat birikmalari

examples.t: It was a major problem for us.
examples.uz: Bu biz uchun jiddiy muammo edi.

scenes.say: More adjective collocations: big mistake, major problem, fast food, quick shower, close friend, full-time job and great success.
scenes.say_native: Yana foydali birikmalar. Big mistake — katta xato, major problem — jiddiy muammo. Fast food — tez tayyorlanadigan ovqat, lekin “quick shower” — tez dush, chunki shower bilan quick ishlatiladi. Close friend — yaqin do‘st. Full-time job — to‘liq ish kuni, part-time job — yarim kunlik ish. Great success — katta muvaffaqiyat. Bu juftliklarda sifatni almashtirsangiz, ma’no o‘zgarmaydi, lekin gap g‘alati eshitiladi. Masalan, fast shower deyilmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Yana: big mistake, major problem, fast food, quick shower, close friend, full-time job, great success.

scenes.title: Sifat tanlashdagi xatolar
scenes.say: Four wrong adjective choices. Heavy rain, heavy traffic, high price and quick shower. The Uzbek adjective does not always match the English one.
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda o‘zbekcha sifatlar xato tanlovga olib keladi. “Qattiq yomg‘ir” — heavy rain, strong emas. “Katta tirbandlik” — heavy traffic, big emas. “Baland narx” — high price, tall emas, chunki tall faqat bo‘y uchun, ya’ni odam yoki bino balandligi uchun. “Tez dush” — quick shower, fast emas. Har bir ot uchun uning odatiy sifatini yodlab oling va tarjima qilishga urinmang.
scenes.say_uz: Heavy rain, heavy traffic, high price, quick shower. O‘zbekcha sifat har doim inglizchasiga mos kelmaydi.

scenes.title: Sifatni tanlang
scenes.say: Choose the right adjective. One: strong or heavy wind. Two: high or tall prices. Three: deep or high sleep. Four: major or fast problem. Five: strong or heavy rain.
scenes.say_native: Beshta juftlikdan to‘g‘risini tanlang. Birinchi: wind uchun strong yoki heavy. Ikkinchi: prices uchun high yoki tall. Uchinchi: sleep uchun deep yoki high. To‘rtinchi: problem uchun major yoki fast. Beshinchi: rain uchun strong yoki heavy. To‘liq birikmani ayting.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri sifatni tanlang: shamol, narxlar, uyqu, muammo, yomg‘ir.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: strong wind. Two: high prices. Three: deep sleep. Four: major problem. Five: heavy rain.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Strong wind. High prices. Deep sleep. Major problem. Heavy rain. Eslab qoling: shamol “strong”, yomg‘ir “heavy”, ikkalasi ham o‘zbekchada “kuchli” yoki “qattiq” bo‘lsa-da, inglizchada boshqa so‘z kerak. Agar to‘rttadan ko‘pini topgan bo‘lsangiz, tilni sezish qobiliyatingiz yaxshi rivojlanmoqda.
scenes.say_uz: Strong wind. High prices. Deep sleep. Major problem. Heavy rain.

scenes.title: Ravish va sifat birikmalari

examples.t: I'm deeply grateful for your help.

scenes.say: Adverbs also have partners. We say highly unlikely, deeply grateful, fully aware, completely different and strongly agree.
scenes.say_native: Ravishlar ham o‘z sheriklarini tanlaydi. Highly unlikely — ehtimoldan juda yiroq, highly recommended — juda tavsiya etiladi. Deeply grateful — chin dildan minnatdor. Fully aware — to‘liq xabardor. Completely different — mutlaqo boshqacha. Strongly agree — qat’iy qo‘shilmoq. O‘zbek tilida hammasiga “juda” deymiz, inglizchada esa very har doim mos kelmaydi. “Very unlikely” mumkin, lekin highly unlikely ancha professional va tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Ravishlarning ham sheriklari bor: highly unlikely, deeply grateful, fully aware, completely different, strongly agree.

scenes.title: Ish mavzusi
scenes.say: Work collocations: meet a deadline, attend a meeting, run a business, earn a living, apply for a job and hand in your notice.
scenes.say_native: Endi mavzular bo‘yicha birikmalarni o‘rganamiz. Birinchisi ish. Meet a deadline — muddatga ulgurmoq. Attend a meeting — yig‘ilishga qatnashmoq, hold a meeting — yig‘ilish o‘tkazmoq. Run a business — biznesni boshqarmoq. Earn a living — kun ko‘rish uchun ishlab topmoq. Apply for a job — ishga ariza bermoq. Hand in your notice — ishdan bo‘shash haqida ogohlantirish bermoq. Mavzu bo‘yicha o‘rganish xotirangizga yordam beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Ish mavzusi: meet a deadline, attend a meeting, run a business, earn a living, apply for a job, hand in your notice.

scenes.title: Sayohat va o‘qish mavzusi

examples.t: I booked a table for eight.

scenes.say: Travel: book a flight, catch a train, miss a train, pack a bag. Study: take an exam, pass an exam, fail an exam, do research, make notes.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu sayohat va o‘qish. Sayohat: book a flight — avia chipta band qilmoq, catch a train — poyezdga ulgurmoq, miss a train — poyezddan qolmoq, pack a bag — sumka yig‘moq. O‘qish: take an exam — imtihon topshirmoq, pass an exam — imtihondan o‘tmoq, fail an exam — yiqilmoq. Do research — tadqiqot qilmoq, make notes — yozuv olmoq. Eslatma: take an exam o‘zbekcha “topshirmoq” ga mos, lekin “give an exam” o‘qituvchi uchun.
scenes.say_uz: Sayohat: book a flight, catch a train, miss a train, pack a bag. O‘qish: take, pass, fail an exam, do research, make notes.

scenes.title: Mavzu bo‘yicha to‘ldiring
board: 2) She ___ her driving test last week. (success)
3) I'd like to ___ a table for two.
4) He decided to ___ his own business.
scenes.say: Complete the sentences. One: meet the deadline. Two: she passed her test. Three: book a table. Four: run a business. Five: make notes. Say the whole sentence.
scenes.say_native: Beshta gapni to‘g‘ri fe’l bilan to‘ldiring. Birinchi: muddatga ulgurmoq. Ikkinchi: haydovchilik imtihonidan muvaffaqiyatli o‘tmoq. Uchinchi: ikki kishiga stol band qilmoq. To‘rtinchi: o‘z biznesini boshqarmoq. Beshinchi: yozuv olmoq. Har bir gapni to‘liq inglizcha ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni to‘g‘ri fe’l bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: meet the deadline. Two: she passed her driving test. Three: book a table. Four: run his own business. Five: make notes.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Meet the deadline. She passed her driving test. I’d like to book a table for two. He decided to run his own business. Don’t forget to make notes. Bu birikmalarning har biri ish, sayohat va o‘qishda har kuni uchraydi. Ularni mavzu bo‘yicha daftaringizga yozib qo‘ying, shunda kerak bo‘lganda tezroq eslaysiz.
scenes.say_uz: Meet. Passed. Book. Run. Make.

scenes.title: Tinglash: hamkasblar suhbati
board: Kate: Did you meet the deadline?
Sam: Yes, but I made a few mistakes.
Kate: Don't worry. Pay attention to the figures.
Sam: I'll take a break first.
scenes.say: Kate: Did you meet the deadline? Sam: Just about. I made a few mistakes, and I took a lot of notes, but I was under heavy pressure. Kate: Well, take a break first, then pay close attention to the figures. Sam: Good idea. I'll do my best.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Ikki hamkasb muddat haqida gaplashyapti. Kate Sam muddatga ulgurdimi, deb so‘raydi. Sam zo‘rg‘a ulgurganini, bir nechta xato qilganini va qattiq bosim ostida bo‘lganini aytadi. Kate avval tanaffus qilishni, keyin raqamlarga e’tibor berishni maslahat beradi. Tinglang va ishlatilgan birikmalarni diqqat bilan sanang.
scenes.say_uz: Kate: Muddatga ulgurdingizmi? Sam: Zo‘rg‘a. Bir nechta xato qildim, ko‘p yozuv oldim, lekin qattiq bosim ostida edim. Kate: Avval tanaffus qiling, keyin raqamlarga diqqat bilan e’tibor bering. Sam: Yaxshi fikr. Qo‘limdan kelganini qilaman.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) Did Sam meet the deadline easily?
scenes.say: Four questions. One: did Sam meet the deadline easily? Two: what did he make? Three: what kind of pressure was he under? Four: what does Kate advise?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Sam muddatga oson ulgurdimi? Ikkinchi: u nimalarni qildi? Uchinchi: u qanday bosim ostida edi? To‘rtinchi: Kate qanday maslahat beradi? Javob berganda dialogdagi birikmalardan foydalaning.
scenes.say_uz: Sam muddatga oson ulgurdimi? U nima qildi? Qanday bosim? Kate nima maslahat beradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) Take a break, pay attention to the figures.
scenes.say: One: no, just about. Two: a few mistakes. Three: heavy pressure. Four: take a break, then pay close attention to the figures.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: yo‘q, zo‘rg‘a ulgurdi. Ikkinchi: bir nechta xato qildi va ko‘p yozuv oldi. Uchinchi: qattiq bosim, ya’ni heavy pressure. To‘rtinchi: tanaffus qilish, keyin raqamlarga diqqat bilan e’tibor berish. Eslab qoling, inglizchada “under pressure” va “heavy pressure” birgalikda keladi, “strong pressure” esa deyilmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q, zo‘rg‘a. Bir nechta xato. Qattiq bosim. Tanaffus qilish va raqamlarga e’tibor berish.

scenes.title: Tinglash: sayohat rejasi
board: Ana: We should book the flights today.
Ben: Prices are high in summer.
Ana: Let's take advantage of the sale.
Ben: Good. I'll pack light and keep in touch.
scenes.say: Ana: We should book the flights today. Prices are high in summer. Ben: True. Let's take advantage of the sale and make a decision tonight. Ana: Agreed. I'll pack a small bag, and we'll keep in touch by phone. Ben: Perfect. I can't wait to take a long holiday.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ana va Ben yozgi ta’tilni rejalashtiryapti. Ana yozda narxlar baland bo‘lgani uchun chiptalarni bugun band qilish kerakligini aytadi. Ben chegirmadan foydalanishni va kechqurun qaror qabul qilishni taklif qiladi. Ular aloqada bo‘lishga kelishadi. Tinglang va oltita birikmani toping.
scenes.say_uz: Ana: Chiptalarni bugun band qilishimiz kerak. Yozda narxlar baland. Ben: To‘g‘ri. Chegirmadan foydalanamiz va bugun kechqurun qaror qabul qilamiz. Ana: Kelishdik. Men kichik sumka yig‘aman, telefon orqali aloqada bo‘lamiz. Ben: Zo‘r. Uzoq ta’tilga chiqishni orziqib kutyapman.

scenes.title: Qaysi birikmalarni eshitdingiz?
scenes.say: Fill in the missing words from the dialogue. One: book the flights. Two: high prices. Three: take advantage of the sale. Four: make a decision. Five: keep in touch.
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, yetishmayotgan so‘zlarni toping. Birinchi: chiptalar bilan qaysi fe’l? Ikkinchi: narxlar bilan qaysi sifat? Uchinchi: take ... of the sale. To‘rtinchi: a decision bilan qaysi fe’l? Beshinchi: in touch bilan qaysi fe’l? Har birini to‘liq birikma qilib ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Dialogdan yetishmayotgan so‘zlarni toping.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: book the flights. Two: high prices. Three: take advantage of the sale. Four: make a decision. Five: keep in touch.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Book the flights. High prices. Take advantage of the sale. Make a decision. Keep in touch. Uchala saralash usuli ham muhim: bu birikmalarning hammasi sayohat mavzusida keladi. Mavzu bo‘yicha o‘rgangan birikmalar eslab qolish uchun juda qulay, chunki miyangiz ularni bir tarmoqqa bog‘laydi.
scenes.say_uz: Book. High. Advantage. Make. Keep.

scenes.title: Xotira usuli: birikmani yodlash
scenes.say: Memory technique one: learn chunks. Write down make a decision, not just decision. Group by topic, and use a collocation dictionary to check partners.
scenes.say_native: Endi xotira usullari. Birinchi usul: so‘zlarni yakka emas, bo‘lak holida yodlang, ya’ni “decision” emas, “make a decision”. Ikkinchi: har bir birikma uchun o‘zingizning gapingizni yozing. Uchinchi: mavzu bo‘yicha guruhlang, shunda miya ularni bir-biriga bog‘laydi. To‘rtinchi: shubha bo‘lsa, collocation lug‘atidan foydalaning, masalan Oxford Collocations Dictionary. Oddiy lug‘at faqat tarjimani beradi, collocation lug‘ati esa sheriklarni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi usul: bo‘laklarni yodlang. Make a decision yozing, faqat decision emas. Mavzu bo‘yicha guruhlang va collocation lug‘atidan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Takrorlash jadvali
board: Say aloud, write, use in a real sentence
scenes.say: Memory technique two: spaced repetition. Review a new collocation after one day, then after three, then a week. Use it in a real sentence each time.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi usul — oraliq takrorlash. Yangi birikmani o‘rgangan kuningiz, keyin ertasiga, to‘rtinchi kuni, bir haftadan va ikki haftadan keyin takrorlang. Har safar uni haqiqiy hayotingizga oid gapda ishlating. Masalan, “I take notes in every lesson”. Daftaringizda uch ustun qiling: birikma, inglizcha misol, o‘zbekcha tarjima. Gapni o‘zingiz tuzsangiz, ancha uzoq eslab qolasiz, chunki shaxsiy ma’no xotirani mustahkamlaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi usul: oraliq takrorlash. Birikmani bir kundan, to‘rt kundan, bir haftadan keyin takrorlang va haqiqiy gapda ishlating.

scenes.title: O‘z gapingizni tuzing
scenes.say: Make three true sentences about yourself. Use take, pay and keep. For example, I take the bus to work.
scenes.say_native: Uchta shaxsiy gap tuzing. Birinchisida take, ikkinchisida pay, uchinchisida keep bilan birikma ishlating. Masalan: “I take notes in every lesson”. Haqiqatan o‘zingizga tegishli gaplar yozing, shunda birikmalar xotirangizga mustahkam o‘rnashadi. Har bir gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingiz haqingizda uchta gap tuzing: take, pay va keep bilan.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: I take the bus to work.
I always pay attention in class.
scenes.say: Possible answers: I take the bus to work. I always pay attention in class. I keep my promises. Yours will be different, and that is good.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar: “I take the bus to work”, “I always pay attention in class”, “I keep my promises”. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, bu juda yaxshi. Tekshirish mezoni oddiy: fe’l ot bilan to‘g‘ri juftlashgan va gap sizning hayotingizga tegishli bo‘lsa, topshiriq bajarilgan. Shu usulni har kuni bitta yangi birikma uchun takrorlasangiz, bir oyda o‘ttizta birikma o‘zlashtirasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Take the bus to work. Pay attention in class. Keep my promises.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: kichik matn
board: make, do, take, heavy, strong, high, meet, pay
scenes.say: Final task. Write five sentences about your week using at least five collocations from today. For example: I made a lot of progress at work, but I took a long break on Friday.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. O‘tgan haftangiz haqida beshta gap yozing va kamida beshta bugungi birikmani ishlating. Masalan: “I made a lot of progress at work, but I took a long break on Friday”. Ish, sayohat yoki o‘qish mavzusini tanlang. Yozib bo‘lgach, baland ovozda o‘qing va fe’llarni tekshiring: make, do, take, pay, keep.
scenes.say_uz: Haftangiz haqida beshta gap yozing va kamida beshta birikma ishlating.

scenes.title: Namunaviy matn
board: I made progress at work and met every deadline.
It was a heavy week, so I took a break on Friday.
I paid a visit to my grandmother and kept in touch with friends.
scenes.say: Model text: I made progress at work and met every deadline. It was a heavy week, so I took a break on Friday. I paid a visit to my grandmother and kept in touch with friends.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “I made progress at work and met every deadline. It was a heavy week, so I took a break on Friday. I paid a visit to my grandmother and kept in touch with friends”. Bu matnda make progress, meet a deadline, take a break, pay a visit va keep in touch kabi birikmalar bor. Sizning matningizda ham kamida beshta shunday juftlik bormi? Yo‘q bo‘lsa, yana bittadan qo‘shing.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: haftam og‘ir edi, shuning uchun juma kuni tanaffus qildim. Buvimnikiga bordim va do‘stlar bilan aloqada bo‘ldim.

scenes.title: Darsning xulosasi
board: Make / do / take / have / pay / keep
scenes.say: Let's review. Learn words in partnerships, not alone. Do not translate directly from Uzbek. Group by topic, write whole sentences and review often.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: so‘zlarni juftlari bilan o‘rganing. Ikkinchi: o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang, chunki dori ichiladi, ammo inglizcha take medicine bo‘ladi. Uchinchi: make va do farqini eslang, natija uchun make, faoliyat uchun do. To‘rtinchi: mavzu bo‘yicha guruhlang. Beshinchi: oraliq takrorlash qiling. Shu besh qadam yuz birikmani yodlashga yordam beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: so‘zlarni juftlari bilan o‘rganing, so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang, mavzu bo‘yicha guruhlang va takrorlang.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
scenes.say: Your homework: write a paragraph that uses fifteen collocations from this lesson. Underline them and check every verb.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bugungi darsdagi o‘n beshta birikmadan foydalanib, bitta paragraf yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘n beshta birikma ishlatilgan, ularning ostiga chizilgan, make va do fe’llari to‘g‘ri va paragraf mantiqan bog‘langan. Keyingi darsda tajriba bo‘lishish, ya’ni ikki daqiqalik monolog aytishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: o‘n beshta birikmadan foydalanib paragraf yozing, ostiga chizing va fe’llarni tekshiring.

homework_uz: Bugungi darsdagi o‘n beshta so‘z birikmasidan foydalanib bitta paragraf yozing. Har bir birikmaning ostiga chizing, make va do fe’llarini tekshiring va paragraf mantiqan bog‘langan bo‘lsin.

quiz.q: She ___ a big mistake in the report.
I have to ___ my homework tonight.
quiz.why_uz: Uy vazifasi bu faoliyat: do homework.
Yolg‘on bilan tell ishlatiladi: tell a lie.

quiz.q: We must ___ the deadline on Friday.
Which is the best way to learn new vocabulary?
quiz.why_uz: Bo‘laklar, ya’ni so‘z sheriklari bilan o‘rganish samaraliroq.
